raidSayLines.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "We've got days of stores, not weeks. The treeline is the pantry now. Learn what's out there."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
It stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. Something displaced a LOT of water is still out there.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Naomi came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
The Mountain Lord stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)

💬 Jiahao pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Nobody met The Landlord — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.

Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
